subject.title: feat: add publisher follow graph API

question: Should ClawHub accept this publisher-follow API as the base product boundary for the stacked follow controls and notifications work?
rationale: The PR adds new persistent private follow state and API-token endpoints; automation can review defects, but maintainers need to decide whether this follow graph should ship as a core API before the stacked UI and notification work lands.

options.title: Review and land base slice after proof
options.body: Accept the API direction if the contributor adds runtime proof and fixes the public contract/generated artifact gaps before merge.

options.title: Pause for stack-level product review
options.body: Hold this base PR until the controls/discovery and notification PRs are reviewed together as one follow-graph product boundary.

options.title: Decline this core API direction
options.body: Close or redirect the work if maintainers decide publisher follows should not become a core ClawHub API surface now.

recommendation.title: Review and land base slice after proof
recommendation.body: Accept the API direction if the contributor adds runtime proof and fixes the public contract/generated artifact gaps before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal for API routes, schema package dist, and nearby HTTP API structure points to Patrick-Erichsen.
